newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo, Smithkline gain after ADR strength.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo, Smithkline gain after ADR strength.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc and Smithkline Beecham Plc gained on Tuesday after strong performances in their ADRs in New York yesterday and positive analyst comment, dealers said.

After rising strongly in London on Monday, Glaxo rose 19p to 10.22 stg by 0944 GMT and Smithkline Beecham advanced 13p to 787p. In New York Glaxo ADRs gained $1-1/4 to $34 and Smithkline Beecham rose $3/4 to $65-3/4.
Traders said the stocks are heavily weighted in the FTSE 100 index and are therefore an obvious target for any international funds seeking to increase their exposure to UK equities.

"We are seeing some follow through from yesterday," said one sales trader. "With favourable research and the general strength of the market, we could see some big movements on little volume ahead of the budget. Don't forget that these two stocks are influenced by the financial future."
Yeterday Glaxo was given an extra boost by positive comment from ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, which said it may upgrade its rating and earnings estimates on the stock.
